name: gajaguar-obsidian-theme
description: Very personalized theme to be used for me on Obsidian.
author: G.A.JAGUAR <dev@gajaguar.com>

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.build: THEME_NAME=$(jq -r .name manifest.json) && mkdir -p "${OBSIDIAN__VAULT_PATH}/.obsidian/themes/${THEME_NAME}" && cp theme.css manifest.json "${OBSIDIAN__VAULT_PATH}/.obsidian/themes/${THEME_NAME}"
